So I'm going to a big public university downtown after going to a small private school for High School. How do I not die?
Pro tips for a college freshman

Are you also moving to a student house or a dorm? If no, t then sure it's a whole lot bigger with a lot more people, and maybe a bit harder (intellectual wise) but in the end as long as you don't slack off you'll be fine.

A few things:

  • Don't pretend your student loans are magic. They're real. I've been watching a lot of people these days take out student loans like Halloween candy and then put their fingers in their ears. "La lala if I ignore it then it's not a problem, la lala" Now it's biting them in the ass once they get out of college. Take out the bare minimum you need to get by.
  • Living like a poor college student is good practice for saving money in the real world. Use this as an opportunity to cut your life down to the things that matter. Once you're making $50K/year you can live just the way you are now and put more than half your paycheck toward paying down loans and saving up. (I have family that did this and now, ten years out of college, they are FILTHY RICH and enjoy it. Meanwhile the party-hearty crowd blows all their money as soon as they get it.)
  • Take advantage of campus resources. Most colleges offer free tutoring from upperclassmen, and it's rarely if ever used. You know that $500 textbook? They probably have copies of it in the library. Join a study group - if there isn't one, then create one!
  • Don't get too involved with leisure activities. I know it's fun. There's always going to be someone on campus ready to play a game or hang out with you, but don't let that get in the way of studying. Be jealous with your time - it's valuable, so why waste it on ultimate frisbee? Remember, that guy is probably on the verge of failing his classes. So will you, if you spend all your time with him.
